_comment: Rentumo-ONLY market map for the Conversions connector. This datasource covers the Rentumo brand exclusively — NOT Adsumo, Printumo, Bidumo, Monetumo, Photumo, or JLA. Each entry maps a market code to the feed slug used in the public S3 URLs (utm-feed-rentumo-<feed>.json and google-ads-offline-conversions-feed-rentumo-<feed>.csv on the kuhamia bucket). The feeds are PUBLIC (no auth / no secret). The feed slug is the lowercased market code. Markets whose feed is not yet generated upstream (currently UK, BR) will surface a per-market 'feed not available' error rather than failing the whole call. To change this list without rebuilding the image, mount an override file and set RENTUMO_CONV_MARKETS_FILE to its path.
